# Frontend UX

Preserve the app’s friendly, visual experience while making behavior predictable.

- Follow existing component patterns, design tokens, icons, and modal conventions before introducing new ones.
- Make loading, empty, success, validation, and error states explicit and understandable.
- Keep form interactions responsive, forgiving, and keyboard-friendly.
- Use animation to communicate state, not to obscure content or delay essential actions.
- Test the complete user flow after changing shared controls, unit behavior, or the avatar/celebration feedback.
